info.name: ShopSecure V19 Carrier Pickup Settlement and Shipping Control
info.description: Authoritative complete-at-creation escrow, automatic carrier-pickup settlement, custom order tracking, waybill, and audited Chowdeck-control workflows. Run after authentication has populated {{jwt}}. OTP values and provider checkout completion remain manual checkpoints.

item.name: 01 - Buyer-Created Escrow
item.description: The buyer creates the complete order, selects delivery, and pays the entire frozen total from their wallet. No buyer payment link is created; a separate bearer tracking link activates after funding.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('buyerOrderId', data.id); pm.test('No create-time token or link', () => { pm.expect(data).not.to.have.property('shareToken'); pm.expect(data).not.to.have.property('shareableLink'); }); }

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.length).to.be.above(0); pm.environment.set('buyerQuoteId', data[0].quoteId); pm.environment.set('buyerQuoteExpiresAt', data[0].expiresAt); }

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('buyerOrderTotal', data.pricing.totalAmount); pm.test('Buyer creator has no payment link', () => pm.expect(data.buyerPaymentLink).to.eql(null)); }

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); const account = data.topUpInstructions && data.topUpInstructions.virtualAccount; pm.environment.set('walletShortfall', data.shortfall == null ? '' : data.shortfall); pm.environment.set('topUpAccountNumber', account ? account.accountNumber : ''); pm.environment.set('topUpBankName', account ? account.bankName : ''); pm.test('Wallet funded the order', () => pm.expect(data.outcome).to.eql('FUNDED')); if (data.outcome === 'INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS') { pm.environment.set('buyerWalletPaymentKey', ''); console.warn('Top up the displayed DVA, then rerun wallet payment; a new key will be generated.'); if (pm.execution && pm.execution.setNextRequest) pm.execution.setNextRequest(null); } }

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Frozen vendor payout is visible', () => pm.expect(data.vendorPayoutAccount).to.be.an('object')); const link = data.shipping && data.shipping.shopSecureTrackingUrl; pm.expect(link).to.be.a('string'); pm.environment.set('buyerOrderTrackingLink', link); pm.environment.set('buyerOrderTrackingToken', link.split('/').filter(Boolean).pop()); }
pm.test('Full public tracking snapshot returned', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

request.description: Public bearer snapshot. No JWT, guest token, or OTP is required. Anyone holding the link can read the complete buyer/vendor, order, shipment, and escrow data.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.escrowReleasePolicy).to.eql('CARRIER_PICKUP'); pm.environment.set('payoutReference', `shopsecure_order_${pm.environment.get('buyerOrderId')}_payout`); if (data.carrierPickupConfirmedAt) pm.test('Automatic settlement started', () => pm.expect(data.settlementStatus).not.to.eql('NOT_STARTED')); }

request.description: Repeat after an authenticated carrier update reports IN_TRANSIT. New orders automatically release the item amount to the frozen vendor bank recipient; there is no buyer delivery-confirmation mutation.

item.name: 02 - Vendor-Created Escrow
item.description: The vendor creates the complete order and selects delivery. Selection returns the recorded buyer's payment-only link.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('vendorOrderId', data.id); pm.test('No create-time token or link', () => pm.expect(data).not.to.have.property('shareToken')); }
if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.length).to.be.above(0); pm.environment.set('vendorQuoteId', data[0].quoteId); }

item.name: 03 Vendor Selects Quote And Gets Buyer Link

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); const link = data.buyerPaymentLink; pm.expect(link).to.be.a('string'); const token = link.split('/').filter(Boolean).pop(); pm.environment.set('buyerPaymentLink', link); pm.environment.set('buyerPaymentToken', token); pm.environment.set('activeShareToken', token); pm.environment.set('vendorOrderTotal', data.pricing.totalAmount); }

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('buyerPaymentAccessToken', data.guestAccessToken); pm.environment.set('activeGuestAccessToken', data.guestAccessToken); }

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('checkoutReference', data.reference); pm.environment.set('checkoutAuthorizationUrl', data.authorizationUrl); pm.environment.set('checkoutAccessCode', data.accessCode); pm.environment.set('checkoutAmountMinor', Math.round(Number(data.amount) * 100)); }

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); if (data.paymentStatus === 'CONFIRMED') { const link = data.shipping && data.shipping.shopSecureTrackingUrl; pm.expect(link).to.be.a('string'); pm.environment.set('vendorOrderTrackingLink', link); pm.environment.set('vendorOrderTrackingToken', link.split('/').filter(Boolean).pop()); } }

request.description: Repeat after provider payment and after carrier pickup until the expected payment, shipping, or automatic settlement state appears.

exec: pm.test('Full public tracking snapshot returned', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

request.description: Run after request 08 reports CONFIRMED payment and captures the tracking token. No JWT, guest token, or OTP is required; the bearer response includes complete buyer/vendor, order, shipment, and escrow data.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.escrowReleasePolicy).to.eql('CARRIER_PICKUP'); pm.environment.set('payoutReference', `shopsecure_order_${pm.environment.get('vendorOrderId')}_payout`); if (data.carrierPickupConfirmedAt) pm.test('Automatic settlement started', () => pm.expect(data.settlementStatus).not.to.eql('NOT_STARTED')); }

request.description: Repeat after an authenticated carrier update reports IN_TRANSIT. New orders automatically release the item amount to the frozen vendor bank recipient; no delivery OTP is required.

item.name: 03 - Opposite-Party-Paid Waybill
item.description: The creator supplies both parties, chooses the payer role, owns quote selection, and receives a payment-only link after selection.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('waybillPublicId', data.details.publicId); pm.test('No creation link', () => pm.expect(data.paymentLink).to.eql(null)); }

item.name: 03 Creator Selects Quote And Gets Payer Link

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); const link = data.paymentLink; pm.expect(link).to.be.a('string'); pm.environment.set('waybillPaymentLink', link); pm.environment.set('waybillPaymentToken', link.split('/').filter(Boolean).pop()); pm.environment.set('waybillPaymentLinkExpiresAt', data.paymentLinkExpiresAt); }

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('waybillPaymentLink', data.paymentLink); pm.environment.set('waybillPaymentToken', data.paymentLink.split('/').filter(Boolean).pop()); pm.environment.set('waybillPaymentLinkExpiresAt', data.expiresAt); pm.environment.set('waybillPaymentChallengeId', ''); pm.environment.set('waybillPaymentAccessToken', ''); pm.environment.set('waybillCheckoutReference', ''); pm.environment.set('waybillAuthorizationUrl', ''); pm.environment.set('waybillCheckoutAccessCode', ''); pm.environment.set('waybillCheckoutAmountMinor', ''); pm.environment.set('waybillCheckoutKey', pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}')); }

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('waybillCheckoutReference', data.reference); pm.environment.set('waybillAuthorizationUrl', data.authorizationUrl || ''); pm.environment.set('waybillCheckoutAccessCode', data.accessCode || ''); pm.environment.set('waybillCheckoutAmountMinor', Math.round(Number(data.amount) * 100)); }
if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test('Creator payer has no link', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().paymentLink).to.eql(null));

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('creatorPayWaybillCheckoutReference', data.reference); pm.environment.set('creatorPayWaybillAuthorizationUrl', data.authorizationUrl || ''); pm.environment.set('creatorPayWaybillCheckoutAccessCode', data.accessCode || ''); pm.environment.set('creatorPayWaybillCheckoutAmountMinor', Math.round(Number(data.amount) * 100)); }

item.name: 06 - Admin Chowdeck Control
item.description: Requires an ADMIN JWT. The default target mode is OFF so an accidental collection run cannot activate Chowdeck.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('chowdeckControlVersion', data.version); pm.environment.set('chowdeckConfiguredMode', data.configuredMode); pm.test('No provider secret is exposed', () => { pm.expect(data).not.to.have.property('secretKey'); pm.expect(data).not.to.have.property('apiKey'); }); }

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('chowdeckControlVersion', data.version); pm.environment.set('chowdeckConfiguredMode', data.configuredMode); pm.test('Requested configured mode persisted', () => pm.expect(data.configuredMode).to.eql(pm.environment.get('chowdeckTargetMode'))); }
if (pm.response.code === 409) console.warn('Control changed concurrently. Run Get Chowdeck Control and review before retrying.');

item.name: 07 - Chowdeck Callback Helper
item.description: Backend-only helper for a controlled local/test Chowdeck integration. The callback is unsigned and acts only as a signal to fetch canonical delivery state with the configured Chowdeck integration key. Never use synthetic callbacks against production.

exec: if (!pm.environment.get('chowdeckWebhookReference')) throw new Error('Set chowdeckWebhookReference to a persisted Chowdeck order or waybill reference before running this helper.');

request.description: Set chowdeckWebhookReference to an exact persisted Chowdeck order or waybill reference. Callback status fields are intentionally omitted because the backend ignores them and performs authenticated GET /relay/delivery/{reference}. Unknown references deliberately return the same 200 response, so verify the resulting state through order or waybill tracking.
